# Vault Human

> Vault Human is a family of professional practices - estate law, AI & systems, leadership coaching, and development advisory - held in one relationship.

## About
Vault Human is part of Vault Human, a family of professional practices founded by Russ Michaels (legal name Russ Michael Schmidtberger). The premise: a person's law, work, money, and relationships are one connected system, and the professional services industry fragments them only because the providers are fragmented.

Contact: (888) 833-2510 · https://www.vaulthuman.com

## Practices
- Tercet Law - estate planning, trusts, and business succession. Licensed in Alabama. Flat-fee plans from $1,500. https://www.tercetlaw.com
- Fretwork Systems - AI and workflow systems for lean teams on Microsoft 365. Fixed-scope, United States. https://www.fretworksystems.com
- Triplicity - leadership and partnership coaching for founders and operators. United States. https://triplicityadvisory.com
- CSH Vault Consulting - development, real-estate, and capital-strategy advisory. https://www.csh-vault.com
- Vault Human - the parent practice holding all four. https://www.vaulthuman.com

- Russ Michaels is licensed to practice law in Alabama only. Texas admission is pending.
- Tercet Law publishes its prices: $1,500 Essential, $3,500 Family Trust, $6,500 Legacy & Business.
